svg.title: How every planning stage runs
svg.desc: PRD, SPEC, TECHSPEC and TASKS all follow the same five steps: research, ask, write, validate, approve. A failed validation loops back to write.

svg.text: PRD, SPEC, TECHSPEC and TASKS follow the same five steps. Nothing is a template: each skill reads the code first.
